annotations.title: Check a saved search for new homes

description: Return only the listings first seen by Huisly within the last window_hours (at most 168, one week) for a search_token from search_listings, or say explicitly that there are none. Built for scheduled checks that the user sets up, for example daily or every few hours. Each call returns a refreshed search_token; a token unused for 30 days expires.

language.description: Language of huisly.nl links and of area-figure labels: en (default) or nl

search_token.description: The search_token from search_listings or an earlier get_new_listings call

window_hours.description: How far back to look, in hours (1 to 168); match it to how often you check

name: get_new_listings
